age.evidence: Twenty-five male and 8 female TRAP2;Ai14 mice (12-18 weeks old) were used

sex.evidence: Twenty-five male and 8 female TRAP2;Ai14 mice (12-18 weeks old) were used for c-Fos-immunofluorescence (IF) mapping.

dosing.evidence: Mice were administered saline or psilocybin (2 mg/kg, i.p.) ... After a 2-week washout, mice were injected again with saline or psilocybin (without 4-OHT), according to a crossover design

group_housing.evidence: Treatment conditions were consistent across cage mates.

enrichment_housing.evidence: not reported (home cage described as 'familiar home cage (corncob bedding)' but no further enrichment information provided)

assays.assay_description: Head twitches counted following i.p. psilocybin (2 mg/kg) vs saline in a separate cohort of male mice to validate drug lot potency. Apparatus and session duration not specified.

application_type.evidence: Mice were injected with saline or psilocybin (2 mg/kg)

setup_restrain.evidence: HTR assessed via established methodology in freely moving mice

time_to_assay.evidence: the same lot of which induced head twitches as assessed via established methodology [23]

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin (2 mg/kg, i.p.) significantly increased head twitch counts (19.6 ± 2.4) compared to saline (1.3 ± 0.3) in male mice, confirming drug lot potency.
outcomes.evidence: the same lot of which induced head twitches as assessed via established methodology [23] in a separate cohort of male mice (saline = 1.3 ± 0.3 [n = 3]; psilocybin = 19.6 ± 2.4 [n = 4]; p < 0.01; two-tailed t-test)

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Single total count reported, no within-session time course

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No transition or sequence analysis reported

B4_ethological.evidence: Head-twitch response is explicitly excluded from ethological behaviours per rubric

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Assessed via established methodology, not stated to use pose estimation or ML classifier

E1_environment_type.evidence: Apparatus not specified; HTR typically performed in standard observation chamber

E2_shelter.evidence: Not reported; standard HTR chamber has no shelter

E8_food_water.evidence: Not reported; standard short HTR test does not include food/water

judge_notes: The primary methodology of this paper is whole-brain c-Fos immunofluorescence mapping with LSFM — a histological/anatomical readout that is explicitly excluded from scoring per the rubric. No behavioural assay was performed on the main experimental cohort during the 2-h post-injection confinement period (no behavioural measures reported).
The only true behavioural assay was a Head Twitch Response measured in a separate validation cohort of male mice to confirm psilocybin lot potency. Included as the single assay.
Dosing schedule scored as 'repeated' because mice received psilocybin twice (initial TRAP labeling injection + second injection 2 weeks later under crossover design).
Sex n's reflect the c-Fos mapping cohort (25M/8F). The HTR validation cohort was a separate group of male mice only (n=3 saline, n=4 psilocybin).
GLM candidate included no assays; qwen and gptoss both identified HTR. Consolidated to a single HTR entry.
